title: Rama shows the captivating scenery of Chitrakuta to Seetha
introduction: Rama describes the beauty of Chitrakuta mountain to Seetha. He delightfully shows her the various colourful minerals, several kinds of birds and animals, several type of trees with flowers and fruit, as also the enchanting springs and Cascades in the mountain. Thus, he also diverts his own mind in seeing that captivating scenery.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 94th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घ काल उषितः तस्मिन् गिरौ गिरि वन प्रियः |
विदेह्याः प्रियमाकान्क्षन् स्वम् च चित्तम् विलोभयन्
अथ दाशरथिः चित्रम् चित्र कूटम् अदर्शयत् |
भार्याम् अमर सम्काशः शचीम् इव पुरम् दरः
verses.iast:
dīrgha kāla uṣitaḥ tasmin girau giri vana priyaḥ |
videhyāḥ priyamākānkṣan svam ca cittam vilobhayan
atha dāśarathiḥ citram citra kūṭam adarśayat |
bhāryām amara samkāśaḥ śacīm iva puram daraḥ
verses.translation: Having dwelt for some time in that mountain, Rama, who resembled God, who liked mountains and groves, who desired Seetha's happiness and himself delightful in his mind, began to point out the beauty of Chitrakuta to his consort, as Indra the god of celestials converses with Shachi the wife of Indra, saying:

glosses.meaning: as Indra the god of celestials
with Shachi the wife of Indra (saying:)

verses.devanagari:
न राज्याद् भ्रंशनम् भद्रे न सुहृद्भिर् विना भवः |
मनो मे बाधते दृष्ट्वा रमणीयम् इमम् गिरिम्
verses.iast:
na rājyād bhraṃśanam bhadre na suhṛdbhir vinā bhavaḥ |
mano me bādhate dṛṣṭvā ramaṇīyam imam girim
verses.translation: "O, my good lady! By seeing this beautiful mountain, neither the loss of kingdom nor the non-existence of friends distresses my mind."

verses.devanagari:
पश्य इमम् अचलम् भद्रे नाना द्विज गण आयुतम् |
शिखरैः खम् इव उद्विद्धैर् धातुमद्भिर् विभूषितम्
verses.iast:
paśya imam acalam bhadre nānā dvija gaṇa āyutam |
śikharaiḥ kham iva udviddhair dhātumadbhir vibhūṣitam
verses.translation: "O, my good lady! Behold this mountain, abounding with flocks of birds of every kind where minerals lie and crowned with peaks that seem to project upwards to the sky."

glosses.meaning: abounding with flocks of birds of every kind

verses.devanagari:
केचिद् रजत सम्काशाः केचित् क्षतज सम्निभाः |
पीत माज्जिस्थ वर्नाः च केचिन् मनि वर प्रभाः
पुष्य अर्क केतुक आभाः च केचिज् ज्योती रस प्रभाः |
विराजन्ते अचल इन्द्रस्य देशा धातु विभूषिताः
verses.iast:
kecid rajata samkāśāḥ kecit kṣataja samnibhāḥ |
pīta mājjistha varnāḥ ca kecin mani vara prabhāḥ
puṣya arka ketuka ābhāḥ ca kecij jyotī rasa prabhāḥ |
virājante acala indrasya deśā dhātu vibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "Some areas of the mountain are encrusted with minerals, having appearance of silver, some resembling blood, some yellowish, some red as madder, some sparkle like precious stones, some possessing, the luster of topaz and crystal and a hue of Ketaka flower and some sparkle with the splendour of a kind of gem called Jyotirasa."

glosses.meaning: some possessing the luster of topaz and crystal and the hue of Ketaka flower
with the splendour of a kind of gem called Jyotirasa.

verses.devanagari:
नना मृग गण द्वीपि तरक्षु ऋक्ष गणैर् वृतः |
अदुष्टैर् भात्य् अयम् शैलो बहु पक्षि समाकुलः
verses.iast:
nanā mṛga gaṇa dvīpi tarakṣu ṛkṣa gaṇair vṛtaḥ |
aduṣṭair bhāty ayam śailo bahu pakṣi samākulaḥ
verses.translation: "The mountain is filled with tame beasts of every kind, tigers, panthers and bears, and is enlivened by a flock of many birds."

glosses.meaning: by a flock of many birds.

verses.devanagari:
आम्र जम्बु असनैर् लोध्रैः प्रियालैः पनसैर् धवैः |
अन्कोलैर् भव्य तिनिशैर् ब्लिव तिन्दुक वेणुभिः
काश्मर्य् अरिष्ट वरणैर् मधूकैः तिलकैः तथा |
बदर्य् आमलकैर् नीपैर् वेत्र धन्वन बीजकैः
पुष्पवद्भिः फल उपेतैः चायावद्भिर् मनो रमैः |
एवम् आदिभिर् आकीर्णः श्रियम् पुष्यत्य् अयम् गिरिः
verses.iast:
āmra jambu asanair lodhraiḥ priyālaiḥ panasair dhavaiḥ |
ankolair bhavya tiniśair bliva tinduka veṇubhiḥ
kāśmary ariṣṭa varaṇair madhūkaiḥ tilakaiḥ tathā |
badary āmalakair nīpair vetra dhanvana bījakaiḥ
puṣpavadbhiḥ phala upetaiḥ cāyāvadbhir mano ramaiḥ |
evam ādibhir ākīrṇaḥ śriyam puṣyaty ayam giriḥ
verses.translation: "This mountain abounds with such type of trees as mangoes, rose-apples and Asanas laden with flowers and fruits, affording magnificient shade, and pleasing to the mind, Lodhras, Priyalas (commonly called Payals), bread-fruit trees, Dhavas, Ankolas, Bhavyas and Tinisas, Bilvas (Bel trees), Tindukas and bamboos, Kashmaris, margosas and Varaas, Madhukas; Tilaks, jujube trees, emblic myrobalans, Kadamoos, came, Dhanvanas and pomegranates, enhancing its beauty."

verses.devanagari:
शैल प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु पश्य इमान् काम हर्षणान् |
किन्नरान् द्वंद्वशो भद्रे रममाणान् मनस्विनः
verses.iast:
śaila prastheṣu ramyeṣu paśya imān kāma harṣaṇān |
kinnarān dvaṃdvaśo bhadre ramamāṇān manasvinaḥ
verses.translation: "O, my good lady! See these Kinnaras, thrilling to be looked at, in their high spirits, wandering in couples in these lovely mountain-plains."

verses.devanagari:
शाखा अवसक्तान् खड्गामः च प्रवराण्य् अम्बराणि च |
पश्य विद्याधर स्त्रीणाम् क्रीडेद् देशान् मनो रमान्
verses.iast:
śākhā avasaktān khaḍgāmḥ ca pravarāṇy ambarāṇi ca |
paśya vidyādhara strīṇām krīḍed deśān mano ramān
verses.translation: "Behold their swords hanging on the trees, their excellent swords and the charming retreats, where vidyadharas and their women sport."

verses.devanagari:
जल प्रपातैर् उद्भेदैर् निष्यन्दैः च क्वचित् क्वचित् |
स्रवद्भिर् भात्य् अयम् शैलः स्रवन् मद इव द्विपः
verses.iast:
jala prapātair udbhedair niṣyandaiḥ ca kvacit kvacit |
sravadbhir bhāty ayam śailaḥ sravan mada iva dvipaḥ
verses.translation: "This mountain resembles an elephant with ichors flowing from its forehead, as from its crevices, springs and cascades flow here and there."

glosses.meaning: with ichors flowing from its forehead

verses.devanagari:
गुहा समीरणो गन्धान् नाना पुष्प भवान् वहन् |
घ्राण तर्पणम् अभ्येत्य कम् नरम् न प्रहर्षयेत्
verses.iast:
guhā samīraṇo gandhān nānā puṣpa bhavān vahan |
ghrāṇa tarpaṇam abhyetya kam naram na praharṣayet
verses.translation: "Who would not be filled with delight, by these glades from which fragrance of various flowers issues, pleasing to the senses?"

glosses.meaning: would not be filled with delight

verses.devanagari:
यदि इह शरदो अनेकाः त्वया सार्धम् अनिन्दिते |
लक्ष्मणेन च वत्स्यामि न माम् शोकः प्रधक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
yadi iha śarado anekāḥ tvayā sārdham anindite |
lakṣmaṇena ca vatsyāmi na mām śokaḥ pradhakṣyati
verses.translation: "O, irreproachable lay! If I am live with you and Lakshmana for many autumns here, grief will not overpower me."

glosses.meaning: will not get the upper hand over

verses.devanagari:
बहु पुष्प फले रम्ये नाना द्विज गण आयुते |
विचित्र शिखरे ह्य् अस्मिन् रतवान् अस्मि भामिनि
verses.iast:
bahu puṣpa phale ramye nānā dvija gaṇa āyute |
vicitra śikhare hy asmin ratavān asmi bhāmini
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! Seeing this mountain laden with many flowers and fruit, the enchanting resort of flocks of birds as also the ravishing peaks of the mountain, I am really captivated."

glosses.meaning: laden with many flowers and fruit

verses.devanagari:
अनेन वन वासेन मया प्राप्तम् फल द्वयम् |
पितुः च अनृणता धर्मे भरतस्य प्रियम् तथा
verses.iast:
anena vana vāsena mayā prāptam phala dvayam |
pituḥ ca anṛṇatā dharme bharatasya priyam tathā
verses.translation: "By residing in the forest, a two-fold advantage is secured by me; freedom from debt to my father in regards my duty and Bharata's happiness."

glosses.meaning: vana vaasena = by residing in the forest

verses.devanagari:
वैदेहि रमसे कच्चिच् चित्र कूटे मया सह |
पश्यन्ती विविधान् भावान् मनो वाक् काय सम्यतान्
verses.iast:
vaidehi ramase kaccic citra kūṭe mayā saha |
paśyantī vividhān bhāvān mano vāk kāya samyatān
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! Are you happy with me on this Chitrakuta mountain, seeing various objects agreeable to your thought word and temperament?"

verses.devanagari:
इदम् एव अमृतम् प्राहू राज्नाम् राज ऋषयः परे |
वन वासम् भव अर्थाय प्रेत्य मे प्रपितामहाः
verses.iast:
idam eva amṛtam prāhū rājnām rāja ṛṣayaḥ pare |
vana vāsam bhava arthāya pretya me prapitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: "My paternal great grand fathers the ancient royal sages have said that for a king to obtain liberation after death, such a residence in the forest is nectar like."

glosses.meaning: residence as such in the forest

verses.devanagari:
शिलाः शैलस्य शोभन्ते विशालाः शतशो अभितः |
बहुला बहुलैर् वर्णैर् नील पीत सित अरुणैः
verses.iast:
śilāḥ śailasya śobhante viśālāḥ śataśo abhitaḥ |
bahulā bahulair varṇair nīla pīta sita aruṇaiḥ
verses.translation: "Hundreds and multitude of rocks of this extensive mountain are shining around in multifarious colours like blue, yellow, white and red."

verses.devanagari:
निशि भान्त्य् अचल इन्द्रस्य हुत अशन शिखा इव |
ओषध्यः स्वप्रभा लक्ष्म्या भ्राजमानाः सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
niśi bhānty acala indrasya huta aśana śikhā iva |
oṣadhyaḥ svaprabhā lakṣmyā bhrājamānāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: "Thousands of herbs of this Chitrakuta mountain, glittering with their lovely light, are sparkling like points of fire."

glosses.meaning: glittering svaprabhaalakSmyaa = with their lovely light

verses.devanagari:
केचित् क्षय निभा देशाः केचिद् उद्यान सम्निभाः |
केचिद् एक शिला भान्ति पर्वतस्य अस्य भामिनि
verses.iast:
kecit kṣaya nibhā deśāḥ kecid udyāna samnibhāḥ |
kecid eka śilā bhānti parvatasya asya bhāmini
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! Some parts of this mountain resemble mansions, some look like parks and some others appear like a single pile."

verses.devanagari:
भित्त्वा इव वसुधाम् भाति चित्र कूटः समुत्थितः |
चित्र कूटस्य कूटो असौ दृश्यते सर्वतः शुभः
verses.iast:
bhittvā iva vasudhām bhāti citra kūṭaḥ samutthitaḥ |
citra kūṭasya kūṭo asau dṛśyate sarvataḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: "Chitrakuta appears as though emerged, having split the earth. This summit of Chitrakuta appears charming on all sides."

verses.devanagari:
कुष्ठ पुम्नाग तगर भूर्ज पत्र उत्तरच् चदान् |
कामिनाम् स्वास्तरान् पश्य कुशेशय दल आयुतान्
verses.iast:
kuṣṭha pumnāga tagara bhūrja patra uttarac cadān |
kāminām svāstarān paśya kuśeśaya dala āyutān
verses.translation: "See the leaves of lilies, Sthagara trees, Punnaga trees and Bhurja trees heaped with flowers of water-lilies form the cozy beds of voluptuaries."

verses.devanagari:
मृदिताः च अपविद्धाः च दृश्यन्ते कमल स्रजः |
कामिभिर् वनिते पश्य फलानि विविधानि च
verses.iast:
mṛditāḥ ca apaviddhāḥ ca dṛśyante kamala srajaḥ |
kāmibhir vanite paśya phalāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! Look at the garlands of lotus-flowers crushed and thrown aside by voluptuaries as also fruits of every kind that have been tasted."

verses.devanagari:
वस्वौक साराम् नलिनीम् अत्येति इव उत्तरान् कुरून् |
पर्वतः चित्र कूटो असौ बहु मूल फल उदकः
verses.iast:
vasvauka sārām nalinīm atyeti iva uttarān kurūn |
parvataḥ citra kūṭo asau bahu mūla phala udakaḥ
verses.translation: "This mountain f Chitrakuta with its abundance of roots fruits and water is more beautiful than Vasvankasara better known as Alaka the capital of Kubera the Lord of Riches, Nalini the capital of Indra (the God of celestials) better known as Amaravati and Uttarakuru the country of Eternal Beatitude."

glosses.meaning: with its abundance of roots fruits and water
Nalini the capital of Indra better known as Amaravati
and uttara kuru the country of Eternal Beatitude.

verses.devanagari:
इमम् तु कालम् वनिते विजह्निवामः |
त्वया च सीते सह लक्ष्मणेन च |
रतिम् प्रपत्स्ये कुल धर्म वर्धिनीम् |
सताम् पथि स्वैर् नियमैः परैः स्थितः
verses.iast:
imam tu kālam vanite vijahnivāmḥ |
tvayā ca sīte saha lakṣmaṇena ca |
ratim prapatsye kula dharma vardhinīm |
satām pathi svair niyamaiḥ paraiḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! Strolling with you and Lakshmana during this period of exile, on my part established in the path of the pious, following the highest salutary practices, I shall obtain joy, enhancing the piety of my race."

glosses.meaning: enhancing the piety of my race.
